evidence: höggur Þorgeir til Gauts og klýfur hann í herðar niður. Fékk Gautur af því sári bana.
killer_kin: son of Hávar Kleppsson and Þórelfur dau. of Álfur úr Dölum (ch 2), so maternal first cousin of Þorgils and Illugi Arasynir; sworn brother (fóstbróðir) of Þormóður Bersason (ch 2)
victim_kin: son of Sleita; close kinsman of Þorgils Mársson (ch 9); kinsman (frændi) of Þórarinn ofsi (ch 18)
relation_detail: no tie; Gautur is kin of Þorgeir's earlier victim Þorgils Mársson
note: Killed in his tent at Hraunhöfn while both were waiting to sail.

evidence: Þórir, Austmaður, er lagði spjóti í gegnum Þorgeir en Þorgeir gekk á lagið þar til er hann hjó hann banahögg
killer_kin: son of Hávar Kleppsson and Þórelfur dau. of Álfur úr Dölum (ch 2), so maternal first cousin of Þorgils and Illugi Arasynir; sworn brother (fóstbróðir) of Þormóður Bersason (ch 2)
victim_kin: Norwegian (Austmaður) in the party of Þorgrímur Einarsson and Þórarinn ofsi; no family given (ch 19)
relation_detail: victim's family not given
note: Homonym: not Þórir of Hrófá, whom Þorgeir killed in ch 14. This Þórir dealt Þorgeir a spear-wound before Þorgeir killed him in his last fight.

evidence: bregður Þormóður höggöxi undan skikkju sinni og höggur í höfuð Loðini svo að hann féll þegar dauður
killer_kin: son of Bersi of Dyrðilmýri and Þorgerður (ch 2); sworn brother of Þorgeir Hávarsson (ch 2)
victim_kin: work-slave (verkþræll) at Brattahlíð in Greenland, household of Þorkell Leifsson; no family given (ch 23-26)
relation_detail: slave, no family given
note: Þormóður was wintering (til vistar) in Brattahlíð, so killer and victim were in the same household at the time; same_group is debatable since Þormóður was a lodger, not kin. Rivalry over the woman Sigríður.

evidence: Þormóður höggur þá í höfuð honum og klýfur hann í herðar niður
killer_kin: son of Bersi of Dyrðilmýri and Þorgerður (ch 2); sworn brother of Þorgeir Hávarsson (ch 2)
victim_kin: Þorgrímur trölli Einarsson of Einarsfjörður, Greenland; sisters Þórdís (sons Böðvar, Falgeir, Þorkell, Þórður by Hámundur) and Þórunn (son Ljótur) (ch 23)
relation_detail: no tie; Þorgrímur was one of Þorgeir's killers (ch 19)
note: Revenge for Þorgeir; killing at the Garðar thing.

evidence: Þorbjörn upp kominn hjá þeim og hjó í fang Ólafi. Var það og nóg banasár og falla þeir báðir.
killer_kin: son of Þjóðrekur, goði of Ísafjörður at Laugaból (ch 1); brother Ljótur of Mánaberg; sister Þórdís of Hvoll, whose sons are Vakur and Skarfur (ch 1); housekeeper/concubine Sigríður (ch 1)
victim_kin: son of Hávarður of Blámýri and Bjargey (ch 1); only son
relation_detail: no tie; Sigríður, who left Þorbjörn's household, favoured Ólafur (ch 3-4)
note: Skarfur (Þorbjörn's nephew) first struck Ólafur deeply between the shoulders; Þorbjörn then dealt the blow called 'nóg banasár'. Hávarður later says 'Ólaf son minn er þú drapst saklausan'.

evidence: Þóroddur harðjaxl vó Helga bróður Hróa.
killer_kin: member of Vémundur kögur's party; no family given (ch 6); himself killed in the same fight
victim_kin: brother of Hrói of Klifshagi in Öxarfjörður (ch 5-6); no further family
relation_detail: killer's family not given; no tie stated
note: Fight in which Hrói ambushes Vémundur over Hánefur. Chapter 6 (input hint points later in the saga).

evidence: Þorvaldur son Galta úr Arnarnesi féll í naustdyrunum fyrir Steini
killer_kin: son of Þorbjörn of Árskógur; brother Helgi; sister Ástríður, wife of Steingrímur Örnólfsson of Kroppur (ch 5)
victim_kin: son of Galti skips of Arnarnes (ch 13)
relation_detail: no tie stated; Þorvaldur accompanied Vémundur against Steinn
note: Vémundur then gives Steinn his death-wound in the same encounter.

evidence: hann kom að sleðanum þar sem þeir óku þá hjó hann þegar til Áskels goða og kom í höfuðið
killer_kin: son of Ketill flatnefur (ch 16); 'nokkuð skyldur' (distantly related) to Eyjólfur Valgerðarson (ch 20); probably the Þórir flatnefur whose sons Þorgeir, Þórður illugi and Björn appear later (ch 25, 30)
victim_kin: son of Eyvindur (son of Þorsteinn höfði), goði in Hvammur; brother Helgi, sisters Þorbjörg and Fjörleif (mother of Hávarður); sons Víga-Skúta and Þorsteinn (ch 1); kinsman of Vémundur kögur
relation_detail: no tie stated
note: Áskell hid the wound and died the next day at home; delayed death but the blow is explicit. Ch 20 confirms 'Þórir son Ketils flatnefs ... vó Áskel goða'.

evidence: Már rak á honum spjótið, Hávarði, og vó hann þar
killer_kin: son of Víga-Glúmur Eyjólfsson of Þverá (ch 24; Víga-Glúms saga); 18 years old
victim_kin: of Ísólfstunga, lives with his (unnamed) mother; friend of Víga-Skúta, to whom he carried news (ch 24)
relation_detail: no tie stated
note: Hávarður happened to be at Eyjólfur Þormóðsson's farm by Mývatn when Már came to summon Eyjólfur.

evidence: lagði Illugi spjóti á Skútu ... Og nú var hann þó því sári særður er hann leiddi til bana
killer_kin: son of Þórir flatnefur, whom Skúta had killed; brother Björn (killed by Skúta in the same attack); kinsman of Þóroddur goði Eyvindarson (ch 30)
victim_kin: Víga-Skúta, son of Áskell goði (ch 1); brother Þorsteinn; wife Sigríður, who afterwards marries Þorgrímur Óttarsson (ch 30)
relation_detail: no kin tie; Þórður's father Þórir (son of Ketill flatnefur) killed Skúta's father Áskell (ch 16), and Skúta killed Þórir
note: A lacuna in the manuscript precedes the scene ('Hér er eyða í sögunni'), but the killing itself survives; Þórður illugi is outlawed 'um vígið Skútu'.
